_note: Text for the landing page. Edit the values, never the keys. Words in {braces} are placeholders: keep them as they are -- they become a small button or icon (their labels are the matching entries in the same section).

meta.title: Bartefy — swap what you don’t use
meta.description: Swap things you no longer need for things you want, with people right here in Tbilisi. Zero money involved. A product of ORZOMI.

hero.title: Swap what you
hero.lead: Trade your things for their things with people nearby. No money ever changes hands.

how.title: Three steps from clutter to treasure.
how.step1Title: Put an item on the table
how.step1Body: Snap a photo of something you no longer need. Let people know what you’d like in return.
how.step2Body: Swipe through items near you. See something you like? Offer one of yours in exchange.
how.step3Body: When they accept, a chat opens. Pick a local spot, meet up, and swap.

screens.title: A flea market in your pocket.
screens.body: One item at a time, a chat to agree, and everything you’ve put on the table right in one place.
screens.findsBody: Everything you're offering, and the trade requests waiting for your reply.
screens.discoverBody: Treasures near you, one card at a time.
screens.chatBody: Pick a place and a time, then swap.

apps.title: Bartefy for iPhone and Android is coming soon.
apps.body: We’re building the native apps now, but you can use the full experience today at bartefy.com on any device.
apps.appStoreAlt: Download on the App Store — coming soon
apps.googlePlayAlt: Get it on Google Play — coming soon

install.title: Until then, add Bartefy to your home screen
install.body: bartefy.com installs directly from your browser like a native app: its own icon, full screen, and quick to open.
install.computerSteps: Open bartefy.com → click {installIcon} in the address bar

band.title: Your closet is full of treasure.
band.body: Put your first item on the table today. It’s completely free.
